summary: No existing declaration duplicates the new material (no tangent-coordinate matrix identification or density Jacobian law exists in pinned Mathlib or TauCeti, and the module rename leaves no forwarding stub). But one of the three new volume-density theorems is a defeq restatement of another via Mathlib's `rfl` lemma `tangentCoordChange_def`, the determinant is spelled out instead of using `ContinuousLinearMap.det`, and the proof of `tangentCoordChange_toMatrix` re-derives four located Mathlib lemmas.
